summary.seed_scope: high-risk representative items only, not full 458 list

items.title: Fused infer attention score family
items.risk: Prefill/decode layout, mask, dtype, and metadata semantics may diverge from PT golden.
items.watch_action: Collect PT golden for prefill/decode and compare MS actual across dtype/shape/layout thresholds.
items.relation_note: Maps to ms_custom_ops fused attention operator rows; audit status is separate from row completion status.

items.title: Attention sink fused custom API
items.ms_candidate: mindspore.ops.fused_infer_attention_score or xfail if sink semantics unsupported
items.risk: Sink-specific metadata and workspace behavior may not map to a public MindSpore attention API.
items.watch_action: Confirm sink semantics, workspace requirement, golden output, and xfail reason if no equivalent exists.
items.relation_note: Maps to ms_custom_ops attention sink operator rows; audit status is separate from row completion status.

items.title: Sparse / lightning attention variants
items.risk: Sparse indexer, KV quant inputs, and lightning metadata may differ from MindSpore candidate APIs.
items.watch_action: Group sparse/lightning cases, collect representative masks/index metadata, and verify MS candidate semantics.
items.relation_note: Maps to sparse attention and quant sparse operator rows; exact MS candidate semantics still need validation.

items.title: MLA prolog and preprocess path
items.risk: MLA preprocess/prolog tensor packing and rope/cache layout may diverge from model expectations.
items.watch_action: Capture MLA forward golden and compare candidate outputs including cache side effects.
items.relation_note: Relates both to operator-row risk and omni_models MLA prefill/decode acceptance items.

items.title: Inplace KV cache scatter/update semantics
items.risk: Inplace cache mutation visibility and repeated-index behavior may not match PyTorch/NPU semantics.
items.watch_action: Verify cache before/after mutation, repeated index, empty update, and aliasing behavior.
items.relation_note: Maps to KV cache scatter/update operator rows.

items.title: Paged KV cache scatter update
items.risk: Slot/block mapping and cache visibility directly affect decode correctness.
items.watch_action: Collect PT golden for block tables and compare cache state deltas after MS update.
items.relation_note: Connects operator row risk with vLLM KV cache E2E acceptance items.

items.title: KV RMSNorm + RoPE cache fused path
items.ms_candidate: mindspore.ops.reshape_and_cache + rotary/rmsnorm composition or custom wrapper
items.risk: Fused norm/rope/cache ordering and layout may differ from decomposed MindSpore implementation.
items.watch_action: Compare decomposed MS path against PT fused golden for cache write and final tensor outputs.
items.relation_note: Maps to KV RoPE cache rows and omni_models rotary embedding acceptance.

items.title: Grouped matmul expert compute
items.risk: Expert grouping, token ordering, weight layout, and output restoration must match PT golden.
items.watch_action: Verify expert token distribution, grouped matmul output, and reorder semantics.
items.relation_note: Maps to grouped matmul operator row and omni_models MoE expert compute acceptance.

items.title: MoE local routing and top-k softmax
items.risk: Routing scores, top-k tie behavior, expert token counts, and token order can affect final logits.
items.watch_action: Capture routing tensors and compare top-k indices, weights, expert counts, and restored ordering.
items.relation_note: Maps to MoE routing operator rows and omni_models MoE routing acceptance.

items.title: MoE distributed dispatch/combine
items.risk: Distributed token exchange requires both op semantics and HCCL group/runtime correctness.
items.watch_action: Validate EP token routing on multi-rank golden and separate op mismatch from runtime group issue.
items.relation_note: Op semantics and HCCL runtime must be separated during debugging.

items.title: Distributed group/rank/world-size runtime APIs
items.ms_candidate: MindSpore communication management / HCCL group mapping
items.risk: Rank/group identity mismatch can break TP/EP/PP routing even if ops are correct.
items.watch_action: Audit group creation, rank mapping, and per-rank metadata in E2E golden runs.
items.relation_note: Distributed runtime risk maps to 2.x bridge/distributed items, not custom-op row completion.

items.title: All-to-all and collective communication path
items.risk: Collective shape splits, async behavior, and ordering affect MoE distributed correctness.
items.watch_action: Verify split sizes, checksums, group names, and rank-local outputs under HCCL.
items.relation_note: Collective runtime risk maps to bridge/HCCL tracked items rather than op_dev.

items.title: Stream and event synchronization APIs
items.ms_candidate: MindSpore runtime stream/event equivalents or bridge-managed synchronization
items.risk: Missing synchronization can cause intermittent cache, transfer, or decode failures.
items.watch_action: Trace stream/event use around bridge calls, KV cache updates, and distributed collectives.
items.relation_note: Stream/event risk maps to bridge/runtime acceptance, not custom op development.

items.title: Runtime graph and memory lifecycle APIs
items.ms_candidate: MindSpore runtime memory/graph management or no-op bridge policy
items.risk: Runtime memory/graph APIs may require no-op, replacement, or lifecycle policy to avoid leaks/regressions.
items.watch_action: Define bridge policy and monitor memory lifecycle during long decode/E2E runs.
items.relation_note: Runtime lifecycle risk maps to bridge memory/error recovery items.

items.title: Quant and custom dtype/internal format variants
items.risk: Custom dtype/internal format may be unsupported or out of first-release scope.
items.watch_action: Separate required first-release paths from unsupported quant variants and document xfail reason.
items.relation_note: Candidate for xfail/unsupported classification until first-release scope is confirmed.

items.title: Autocast / AMP semantic migration
items.risk: Autocast scope and dtype policy changes may silently alter numerics.
items.watch_action: Audit dtype context boundaries and compare golden under bf16/fp16/fp32-sensitive paths.
items.relation_note: Semantic dtype/context risk; not yet mapped to a release-gate tracked item.

items.title: Inference/no-grad mode semantics
items.risk: Grad-disabled semantics and tensor alias behavior can differ in converted model code.
items.watch_action: Confirm eval/inference context in model forward, bridge wrapper, and serving path.
items.relation_note: Inference/eval context risk; not a custom op and not yet mapped to a release-gate tracked item.

items.title: Tensor alias/view/storage semantics
items.ms_candidate: MindSpore Tensor view/copy semantics or bridge adapter
items.risk: Alias/view/storage semantics affect bridge conversion, cache visibility, and mutation assumptions.
items.watch_action: Trace alias-sensitive paths and compare tensor identity/view behavior across PT and MS bridge.
items.relation_note: Alias/view/storage risk; intentionally separate from inplace mutation and not yet mapped to a release-gate tracked item.

items.title: Tensor inplace mutation semantics
items.ms_candidate: MindSpore mutation-compatible rewrite or bridge adapter
items.risk: Inplace mutation may not be observable through converted tensors or may require explicit rewrite.
items.watch_action: Identify mutation-sensitive callsites and verify before/after tensor state against PT golden.
items.relation_note: Inplace mutation risk is tracked separately from alias/view/storage; mapping needs callsite validation.

items.title: vLLM Python custom op wrappers
items.ms_candidate: Python/reference behavior or model rewrite; do not develop same-name MindSpore ops
items.risk: vLLM wrapper names can be misread as custom ops but usually represent Python-level composition/reference paths.
items.watch_action: Map wrapper behavior to model or bridge acceptance items and avoid counting as op_dev.
items.relation_note: Composite wrapper/model rewrite risk. Do not develop same-name MindSpore ops.
